prompt:
A high-fidelity visual design mockup of a MOBILE WEB PAGE, portrait phone viewport, full-bleed screen design. Flat screen design only: no phone hardware frame, no browser chrome, no hands, no device photograph. It is a birthday party invitation page in the style of a mid-century graphic art exhibition poster with one big friendly character.

STRUCTURE, top to bottom, as regions of one continuous posted sheet. No navigation bar, no cards, no margins.

REGION 1, the entire screen ground: one flat fully saturated SUN YELLOW, edge to edge, like a silkscreened poster.

REGION 2, the top strip: the words HBD SUMMER PARTY in a dense condensed poster capital, printed small and tracked across the top in deep ink, like an exhibition poster's header line.

REGION 3, the centre and the whole point of the page, occupying the middle 55% of the screen: ONE large anthropomorphic character drawn as flat vector art with confident even-weight thick outlines and no shading — a BIRTHDAY CAKE that is alive. It is a round two-tier cake in warm cream and pool turquoise with exactly FIVE slim lit candles on top. It has two simple round expressive eyes with tiny highlights, a small curved happy mouth, two thin rubber-hose arms and two thin legs with rounded feet. It stands upright, cheerfully, one arm raised in a wave. Around its middle it wears an inflatable pool ring float in watermelon pink. Its five candle flames are small and warm orange. The character is charming, quirky and friendly, drawn for adults rather than for a nursery — clean, confident, minimal, in the manner of a mid-century poster illustration.

REGION 4, beneath the character, large: the date 8.28 and the time 17:00 in a heavy condensed poster capital in deep ink, set on one line, sized so they read as the second loudest thing on the page.

REGION 5, the bottom edge: a narrow strip carrying a small line of Korean text 어반피크닉 워터파티룸 · 분당서현 in tight dense condensed characters in deep ink.

PALETTE, strictly: saturated sun yellow ground, deep near-black ink, warm cream, pool turquoise, watermelon pink, and small warm orange candle flames. No other colour. Flat silkscreen colour, no gradients, no shading, no texture other than a faint print grain.

No people, no human faces, no logos, no photographs, no prices, no invented text beyond what is specified.
